Challenge

Making the project financially viable meant fitting a minimum number of units on the site while staying within a strict height limit. It also had to meet local zoning rules and provide the required public space.

Approach

A simple, efficient design centered on family living, with unit layouts sized for households of five or more. A modern color palette and well-placed urban elements connect the building to its street.

BIM contribution

I modeled the project in Revit, supported design coordination, and produced detail drawings and permit (licensing) drawings.
